leaves.name: Compute pixel distance between two points
acceptance: distancePx(p1, p2) returns Euclidean distance via Math.sqrt((Δx)²+(Δy)²)
Returns 0 when p1 === p2

leaves.name: Calculate polyline length in real-world feet
acceptance: lineLength sums segment pixel distances then divides by pixelsPerFoot
Returns 0 for fewer than 2 points
After two-point calibration, annotation measurement equals pixel length / pixelsPerFoot
leaves.evidence: Loop over segments + totalPx/pixelsPerFoot at geometry.ts:7–14

leaves.name: Compute polygon area via shoelace formula (px² → SF)
acceptance: polygonAreaPx returns |shoelace|/2 in pixels²
polygonAreaSF divides by pixelsPerFoot² to return square feet
Returns 0 for fewer than 3 points

leaves.name: Convert SF to SY and CY
acceptance: sfToSY(area) === area / 9
sfToCY(area, depth) === area * depth / 27
leaves.evidence: Single-expression functions at geometry.ts:32–38; imported by export-utils.ts:3

leaves.name: Format measurement value with unit string and K-abbreviation
acceptance: formatMeasurement(value, unit) returns '1.2K SF' when value >= 1000
Returns '45.3 LF' format for values < 1000
gaps: No unit enum/validation; caller passes arbitrary string — typos silently pass through

leaves.name: Hit-test points against polyline segments and polygon fills
acceptance: pointToSegmentDistance returns clamped perpendicular distance from point to segment
pointInPolygon correctly classifies inside/outside via ray-casting
pointToMarkerDistance returns Euclidean distance to count-marker center
leaves.evidence: All three functions implemented; ray-casting at geometry.ts:59–69

leaves.name: Convert GPS lat/lng to local Cartesian feet relative to origin
acceptance: gpsToLocalFt uses spherical approximation with cosLat longitude correction
Earth radius constant is 20,902,231 ft (mean)
leaves.evidence: Implemented at geo-transform.ts:31–39 with DEG_TO_RAD and EARTH_RADIUS_FT constants
gaps: Flat-earth approximation — valid only for small project extents (<5 mi); no range guard

leaves.name: Solve 2-point similarity transform (scale + rotation + translation)
acceptance: solveAffine2 round-trips each control point's plan coordinate to floating-point precision
Throws when fewer than 2 points or points are identical

leaves.name: Solve 3+ point full affine via least-squares normal equations
acceptance: solveAffine3 returns least-squares 6-DOF affine for 3+ control points
Falls back to solveAffine2 when determinant < 1e-12
estimateError returns non-zero residual for non-collinear points
leaves.evidence: Normal equations solved at geo-transform.ts:77–121; fallback guard at line 108
gaps: estimateError returns plan-pixel residual, not feet — docstring and field name estimatedErrorFt are misleading (confirmed risk in stream doc)

leaves.name: Apply affine calibration to convert live GPS to plan pixel coordinates
acceptance: gpsToplan(cal, gps) converts GPS to local feet then applies stored AffineMatrix
buildGeoCalibration selects solveAffine3 for 3+ points, solveAffine2 for 2

leaves.name: Kalman filter for GPS trace smoothing (predict + update)
acceptance: initKalman seeds state with lat/lng/accuracy/timestamp and zero velocity
updateKalman with high-accuracy measurement pulls state toward new reading
updateKalman with dt <= 0 returns position unchanged (cold-start guard)
leaves.evidence: dt <= 0 guard at line 173; gain = state.accuracy/(state.accuracy+accuracy) at line 180
gaps: KalmanState is never persisted — cold-starts on every GpsTraceControls remount (confirmed debt)

leaves.name: Normalize plan coordinates to scale=1 for geo control points
acceptance: GeoControlPoint.plan is stored normalized to scale=1 so transform is scale-independent
PdfCanvas passes normalized coordinates when building geo calibration
leaves.evidence: Interface comment 'normalized to scale=1' at geo-transform.ts:13; no enforcement function exists in geometry lib
gaps: No normalizeToScale1() helper; callers must manually divide by current scale — contract not enforced

leaves.name: Live measurement recalculation on polygon vertex drag
acceptance: Dragging a polygon vertex updates only that vertex in the points array
polygonAreaSF / lineLength called immediately after vertex update to refresh measurement
leaves.evidence: Vertex-drag/recalc wiring not isolated in the geometry library; geometry.ts functions exist and are callable
gaps: Vertex-drag recalculation coupling lives in PdfCanvas, not testable in isolation

docDrift.claim: estimateError returns non-zero residual in feet (field named estimatedErrorFt)
docDrift.actual: estimateError returns plan-pixel residual divided by control-point count; no scale conversion (geo-transform.ts:143–145)

docDrift.claim: updateKalman: zero-dt update returns position unchanged
docDrift.actual: When dt <= 0, returns state lat/lng replaced by NEW gps.lat/gps.lng (line 173), so it DOES mutate position on zero-dt

proposedDocPatch.addBullet: 6. **Bug** — `updateKalman` zero-dt guard (geo-transform.ts:173) returns `gps.lat/lng` not `state.lat/lng`; acceptance criterion 6 is NOT met.
5. **`estimateError` unit mismatch** — averages plan-pixel residuals with no feet conversion; stored as `estimatedErrorFt` and labelled 'feet'.
6. **`updateKalman` zero-dt semantics** — early-return sets lat/lng from new GPS instead of preserving prior state; duplicate-timestamp events silently teleport the trace.
